segments.text:
V. 23.
Ye will ſurely ſay—That is, your Approbation now outweighs your Prejudices. But it will not be ſo long. You will ſoon aſk, Why my Love does not begin at Home? Why I do not work Miracles here, rather than at Capernaum? It is becauſe of your Unbelief. Nor is it any new Thing for me to be deſpiſed in my own Country. So were both Elijah and Eliſha, and thereby driven to work Miracles among Heathens, rather than in Iſrael.
